text:
Alex R.: quick note — i'm re-checking the offload watermark behavior after the last compaction changes. noticed some jitter on tiny-allocation-heavy runs.
Maya T.: ok, what jitter are you seeing? latency spikes on allocation or eviction stalls? :eyes:
Alex R.: latency spikes ~5-15ms per request when staging pool hits soft watermark, then we trigger lots of async offloads. pattern looks like repeated small evictions + host memcpy.
Samir K.: that smells like thrashing between hotset estimator and prefetch hints. are we dropping hysteresis?
Alex R.: exactly. current defaults: soft=70%, hard=85%, grace_window=100ms. think grace_window too small for tiny allocations.
Jeremy L.: uh — 100ms seems aggressive given memcpy variability across hosts. especially with small pages, copy overhead+mutex contention adds up.
Maya T.: any telemetry showing which allocators hit the soft watermark most? slab vs arena?
Alex R.: slab mostly. small allocs flood slab freelists and then eviction paths try to free up host staging. logs attached: \n```
[evictor] soft_watermark_reached pool=host-staging used=71% free=29% action=async_offload
[evictor] offload_batch size=12 total_bytes=96KB took=12ms
[alloc] slab_alloc retry=1 blocked_ms=6
[evictor] offload_batch size=8 total_bytes=64KB took=14ms
[request] latency p95 +11ms
```
Samir K.: looks like many small offload batches. Could we coalesce small offloads into a periodic batcher? e.g., micro-batcher that waits up to 5ms or N bytes before issuing memcpy?
Alex R.: thinking two levers: increase hysteresis (grace_window) OR add a micro-batcher for small buffered offloads. micro-batcher needs to play nicely with latency SLOs though.
Maya T.: i'd prefer a hybrid: keep grace_window moderate (200-300ms) and enable micro-batcher only when average token size < threshold. That keeps big requests unaffected.
Jeremy L.: agree. Also need safety for pinned pages — micro-batcher must never delay required eviction for pinned->staged transitions that would block a hot request.
Samir K.: propose naming: staged_micro_batcher with params: enabled, max_delay_ms, max_batch_bytes, min_batch_count. propose defaults: enabled=true, max_delay_ms=5, max_batch_bytes=256KB, min_batch_count=4.
Alex R.: sounds reasonable. let's also add a backpressure signal: if memcpy queue grows > M, switch to immediate offload (bypass batching).
Maya T.: and add adaptive hysteresis: if eviction_rate > X over Y seconds, increase grace_window by factor until it stabilizes. protects against repeated churn.
Jeremy L.: wanted to call out cross-tenant fairness: we must ensure micro-batcher doesn't favor high-throughput tenants by aggregating their tiny offloads into big batches that hog PCIe. need per-tenant queues.
Alex R.: good call. implement per-tenant micro-batcher with global admission token bucket. simpler: per-tenant batcher + global batch window aggregator that merges only when under token allowance.
Samir K.: will the global admission token bucket be per-GPU or per-host? prefer per-GPU to bound PCIe saturation.
Maya T.: per-GPU. also expose telemetry: batch_count, avg_batch_ms, bytes_coalesced, bypass_count.
infra-bot: deploy plan: canary config gate 'staged_micro_batcher' on canary pool next rollout. auto-rollback if p95 latency increases > 5% for 10m.
Alex R.: can we sketch a config snippet for runtime?
Samir K.: sure — yaml: \n```
staged_offload:
  micro_batcher:
    enabled: true
    max_delay_ms: 5
    max_batch_bytes: 262144  # 256KB
    min_batch_count: 4
    per_tenant: true
  hysteresis:
    base_grace_ms: 200
    adaptive_window_s: 30
    increase_factor: 1.5
  backpressure:
    memcpy_queue_threshold: 64
    bypass_on_threshold: true
```
Maya T.: love the telemetry additions. please add a counter for 'coalesce_skipped_due_to_hard_watermark' so we can see when safety bypass happens.
Jeremy L.: implementation note: micro-batcher must be lock-free as much as possible. we can use single-writer ring buffers per tenant and a single aggregator thread per GPU.
Alex R.: for rollout: start with per-tenant micro-batcher disabled, hysteresis base_grace_ms=250, then enable micro-batcher on canary after 24h if stable.
Samir K.: i'll pick this up. plan to prototype aggregator + telemetry in the offload worker. target PR by EOD Thursday.
Maya T.: please include unit tests for pinned page immediacy — ensure pinned->staged transitions are never delayed. also add a perf test with many 64-byte allocs to reproduce jitter.
Alex R.: awesome. let's also schedule a short sync after the canary: 30-min check with metrics.
infra-bot: scheduled: canary rollout window 2026-04-02T23:00Z — auto-monitoring enabled.
Samir K.: noted. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Jeremy L.: thanks — i'll review the PR and validate kernel interactions.
Maya T.: thanks — i'll add dashboards for the new telemetry.
Alex R.: closing loop: i'll open a tracking issue with config defaults and rollout steps.
